# WF2 — JARVIS Brain Router v5.3

### Changes from v5.2:
- ✅ Remove: Load Context (require pg → blocked)
- ✅ Remove: Load Tokens (fetch → blocked)
- ✅ Remove: Memory Injector (require pg + fetch → blocked)
- ✅ JARVIS → split: Prepare (Code) + Call OpenRouter (HTTP Request)
- ✅ Dispatch Gate → HTTP Request node
- ✅ persona comes from Vercel payload (User + ethical_profiles + memories)
- ✅ No require(), no fetch() in Code nodes

### Flow:
Vercel → WF1 → WF2 Entry → Extract Payload
→ Prepare JARVIS → Call OpenRouter → Parse & Route
→ Dispatch Gate (HTTP Request) → WF3x

### ENV: N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false required
